label_policy: hindsight over machine-checked repair outcomes: outcome=Kept => (span_embed, strategy_id) POSITIVE; outcome in {RevertedNoProgress, RevertedIo} => HARD-NEGATIVE (fired + compile-gate reject). span_embed is the Issue-107-T2 write-time hashed unigram+bigram bag over the ORIGINAL trigger text, 32-dim i8 x/127.
regeneration: cargo run --release --example rustc_errors_floor --features rustc_errors -- --only driver --dump-fixseq <tmp_root> — then flatten <tmp_root>/.heal/fixseq/run-*.jsonl. Corpus is toolchain-sensitive (known-inverse mutants vs live rustc); the manifest pins the toolchain this snapshot was measured under.
